owner.name: Luis Cordero
owner.bio: Luis Cordero, 35, is a product designer from Guadalajara who has lived in London since 2020 (before that an MA in London in 2017-18 and two years back in Mexico). He joined Acme Studio in Clerkenwell in March 2022 and has been Lead Product Designer since May 2025, managing Hollie, Dev, Kasia and Gabriel and working closely with Marcus, Freya, Zainab and Jae under Priya Raman. In 2026 he leads the Holloway Museum website relaunch and has hired a junior designer who starts in November. He lives with his partner Niamh Gallagher, an audio producer from Cork, and their ginger cat Biscuit, adopted in May 2025. Luis and Niamh lived at Flat 3, 14 Albion Road, Stoke Newington until 27 June 2026 and now live at Flat B, 41 Mallory Road, Clapton. On the side he freelances in Spanish for Mexican clients (a coffee roaster, a boutique hotel in Oaxaca, a dental chain in Monterrey, a craft brewery, a nonprofit), invoicing through his Mexican RFC with his accountant Lupita Ibarra in Guadalajara; his UK accountant Martin Hale folds that income into his self assessment. He runs with Marshgate Runners, plays Thursday five-a-side at Mabley Green, is in a book club he rarely finishes the book for, and has an older sister, Daniela, in Toronto. His parents in Guadalajara use a family group chat, not email. At Acme he sends a short note when he has a decision. At home he leaves anything that needs a scanner until Saturday.

timeline.fact: Start of the mail. Luis is a Senior Product Designer at Acme, living with Niamh at Flat 3, 14 Albion Road, Stoke Newington N16 (since 2023).
Freelance: Tueste Laja y Niebla hires him to redesign its coffee bags; Clínicas Diente de Sierra asks for signage for three clinics.
The Albion Road boiler fails for the first time; no heating or hot water on and off until February 2025.
Christmas in Guadalajara with his parents and Daniela, 19 December to 5 January. Mail goes quiet.
Ski week in Les Arcs with Tom, Callum and Josh, 24-31 January. Josh ends up owing him £40.
Peter Stavros replaces the Albion Road boiler after the third failure.
His road bike is stolen outside 14 Albion Road; insurance claim with Halyard (iCloud address).
Shin splints; six physio sessions with Harriet Lowe until May.
Files his Mexican annual tax return with Lupita Ibarra (deadline 30 April).
Promoted to Lead Product Designer at Acme; Hollie, Dev, Kasia and Gabriel report to him. Biscuit the cat arrives the same month.
Felix Brandt visits from Berlin, 15-19 May, sleeping on the sofa.
Off sick with flu, 14-18 July.
Aisha and Oliver's wedding at Lower Hatherley Barn, Cotswolds; Luis is an usher.
Acme wins Tandem City; Luis leads design.
Lisbon with Niamh, 18-23 September, at Blue Swallow Guesthouse; days out with Rita.
Kestrel Pay app redesign starts; runs to April 2026.
Acme's 2025 offsite in Margate, 6-7 November. Nikhil is in London the same week.
Freelance: Casa Ocotillo's new website goes live; maintenance retainer from December.
Christmas in Cork with Niamh's family, 20 December to 2 January. Mail goes quiet.
Acme wins the Holloway Museum website relaunch; Clínicas Diente de Sierra starts negotiating a retainer with him.
Luis starts leading the Holloway Museum relaunch, launch planned for 1 October 2026.
Niamh starts at Lowtide Audio after leaving Pellam & Rook on 27 February. Clínicas Diente de Sierra's retainer signed 16 March.

Mexico for Daniela's wedding, 14-27 April (wedding Saturday 18 April at Hacienda Los Siete Capulines). Mail goes quiet; Luis meets Lupita in Guadalajara on 22 April; she files the return on 29 April after he is back in London.
Gives notice on Albion Road; they find Flat B, 41 Mallory Road, Clapton on 6 June.
Freelance: Tueste Laja y Niebla approves the rebrand quote ($86,000 MXN + IVA).
Moves to Flat B, 41 Mallory Road, Clapton E5, with Tariq's van.
Holiday in the Scottish Highlands with Niamh, 3-14 August. Mail goes quiet.
Damp patch appears on the Mallory Road bathroom ceiling.
Acme opens the junior designer role; Luis runs the hire.
Freelance: invoices Tueste Laja y Niebla for the balance, due 15 October. He delivered production PDFs on 12 September.
Holloway launch moves from 1 October to 12 November. Luis accepts the Margins talk (3 December).
Marcus tells Luis he's leaving Acme; last day 18 December.
Ellie Ngata accepts the junior designer offer; starts 16 November.
Anchor: Thursday afternoon. Ahead: offsite 5-6 November, Holloway launch 12 November, Jo's surprise 40th 14 November, the Marshgate Half 15 November, Ellie's first day 16 November.

Open at the anchor: Jake needs a week's notice for her laptop (Luis hasn't sent the starter form); Lauren needs tool seats confirmed; Priya wants Luis's onboarding plan before the offsite; Ellie asked on 19 Oct whether she can join the offsite and nobody has answered; Callie's invoice (15% of salary) lands on 16 Nov, her first day.

storylines.summary: 1 Sep 2026: Natasha announces the offsite, Thursday 5 to Friday 6 November at Merefurrow Farm near Faversham. 15 Sep: deposit paid; Rupert sends the room plan (28 beds in 14 shared rooms at the farm; the remaining 10 are at the village inn). 2 Oct: agenda draft; Jonathan opens with 'state of the studio', Luis is asked to run a 90-minute design-critique workshop on Friday morning. 16 Oct: Natasha asks everyone for dietary needs and room shares BY 23 OCTOBER; Luis hasn't replied. Jade needs the final headcount and dietary list by 26 Oct (38 provisional covers, £42 each); the £6,400 balance is due to Rupert on 29 Oct; Philippa is responsible for paying it. Coach leaves Farringdon at 8:30 on the 5th.

storylines.title: Holloway Museum website relaunch
storylines.summary: 9 Feb 2026: kickoff at the museum; launch set for 1 October. March-May: discovery, new collection pages, design signed off 29 May. June-August: Anil builds; Zainab writes the content migration plan for 340 objects. 18 Sep: the museum's collection copy is due and doesn't come. 24 Sep: Sam and Luis tell Margaret 1 October can't hold; 1 Oct: new date Thursday 12 November, agreed by Margaret in writing. 2 Oct: Rhys asks Ian Ferris for DNS access and the old CMS export; still not given at the anchor despite two chasers. 14 Oct: Margaret sends copy for 210 of 340 objects, promises the remaining 130 by 23 Oct. If they miss that date, Margaret needs to approve holding unpublished records out of the November launch. The board's open evening on 19 November is the real deadline. Luis owes Margaret a revised launch checklist by Friday 23 October.

storylines.title: Marcus is leaving
storylines.summary: 12 Oct 2026: Marcus tells Luis, then Priya, he's leaving for a games studio; last day 18 December. 13 Oct: Priya asks Luis to plan the Pennywort handover (Dev to step up, Luis to cover reviews). 15 Oct: Steve Barlow hears and writes, unhappy, asking for a call. 19 Oct: Shona books the exit interview for 10 December. Marcus promised a written handover by 27 November. Dev shadows the November reviews and owns design queries from the December beta. Leaving drinks pencilled for Thursday 17 December; Hollie is collecting for a gift. Luis hasn't yet replied to Steve with a date for the call.

storylines.title: Speaking at Margins
storylines.summary: 24 Sep 2026: Yasmin invites Luis to give a 25-minute talk at Margins on Thursday 3 December at the Red Lion Rooms, Holborn; fee £300 plus a ticket. 25 Sep: Priya says yes, Acme will cover his day. 1 Oct: Luis accepts with a working title, 'Designing for the last 10 metres'. 8 Oct: Yasmin asks for final title, 60-word bio and headshot by 23 October; slides by 13 November; a tech check on 30 November. At the anchor Luis hasn't sent the final title, bio or headshot. Gabriel offered to take the headshot at 12:30 on Friday 23 October at the studio. Yasmin needs printable material for the programme, which closes that day.

storylines.title: Pennywort loyalty app
storylines.summary: 1 Jun 2026: kickoff in Leeds; a points card in an app for 62 shops. July: Freya runs six in-store interviews in Harrogate and Durham. August: Marcus's designs approved; Dev takes checkout. 21 Sep: Steve asks for a 'scan and go' feature that wasn't in scope; Sam writes a change request (£14,500, still unsigned). Beta to 2,000 customers on 1 December. Live at the anchor: the change request, Marcus's exit, and Steve's request for a call with Luis.

storylines.title: Tandem City e-bike unlock flow
storylines.summary: 10 Aug 2026: Chiara asks Acme to fix the e-bike unlock (14% of unlock attempts fail at the dock). The first retainer expires on 25 August; Chiara signs a three-month extension before it lapses. September: Gabriel prototypes a tap-to-unlock flow; Dan insists it works with gloves on. 13-16 Oct: Freya runs 12 street sessions in Hackney. The readout is promised to Chiara for Wednesday 28 October; Kate needs to know by then whether the API changes. Chiara can approve the build on 28 October. If she signs off, build starts 9 November, with a 20 November pilot at six Hackney docks.

storylines.title: Kestrel Pay phase 2 negotiation
storylines.summary: 3 Sep 2026: Arjun asks Fiona for a proposal for phase 2 (recurring invoices and multi-currency settlement). 18 Sep: Fiona and Luis send a statement of work: 14 weeks, £118,000. 9 Oct: client dinner at the Railway Arch Dining Room in Bermondsey (Luis paid, £186.40; Philippa still wants the receipt). 13 Oct: Arjun pushes for £95,000; Fiona offers 12 weeks at £104,000. Arjun promised a decision 'by end of October'. Jae is pencilled in; Priya can't confirm the team until the answer.

storylines.title: Brightwell Trust annual report
storylines.summary: 18 Aug 2026: Helen sends the brief: 32 pages, 1,500 copies, launch at the supporters' evening on 26 November. September: Zainab edits the text; Kasia lays it out. 12 Oct: first proof to Helen; she wants a different cover photo. 20 Oct: second proof sent; Helen hasn't signed off. Terry needs final PDFs by 30 October to deliver by 20 November, and warns that uncoated stock is short this autumn.

storylines.title: Winning the Holloway Museum
storylines.summary: 17 Nov 2025: the museum's tender arrives. 1 Dec: Luis and Fiona submit; 15 Dec: shortlisted. 7 Jan 2026: pitch at the museum (Jonathan, Fiona, Luis). 12 Jan: Margaret writes to say Acme won, budget £146,000.

storylines.title: Kestrel Pay app redesign
storylines.summary: 13 Oct 2025: kickoff. November-December: Freya's diary study with 18 small-business owners. January 2026: new navigation and invoicing designs; Arjun rejects the first dashboard. February: Lena brings in the Fjell typeface. 24 April 2026: the redesigned app ships; app marketplace rating goes from 3.9 to 4.5 by June.

storylines.title: Font licence for Kestrel
storylines.summary: 16 Feb 2026: Lena wants Fjell for the Kestrel rebrand. Luis gets a quote from Ingrid: £4,800 for web and app, up to 250k monthly users. Philippa questions who pays (Kestrel does, through Acme). 20 Mar: licence issued in Kestrel's name. Renewal due March 2027.

storylines.title: Promotion to Lead Product Designer
storylines.summary: 24 Mar 2025: Priya tells Luis she's putting him forward. April: he writes a case; Shona arranges the panel on 23 April. 6 May: offer letter, salary £68,000 to £76,000. 12 May: announced to the studio; four designers move to report to him.

storylines.title: Annual review 2026
storylines.summary: 1 Apr 2026: Shona opens reviews. Luis writes his self-review in Guadalajara the week of the wedding, late. 30 Apr: review with Priya; goals: ship Holloway, hire a junior, speak once in public. 8 May: 4% raise confirmed.

storylines.title: Pitching Tandem City
storylines.summary: 16 Jun 2025: Chiara gets in touch after seeing Acme's Brightwell work. July: two workshops; Gabriel builds a clickable concept for finding a docked e-bike. 26 Aug 2025: Tandem City signs a year's retainer.

storylines.title: Brightwell Trust website rebuild
storylines.summary: October 2024: in build. 11 Nov 2024: Fold & Bind prints the 2024 report with the wrong Pantone on the cover; Terry reprints the covers free by 22 Nov. January 2025: content freeze; Helen's trustees ask for a donate button on every page. 14 March 2025: new site live.

storylines.title: Acme design system v2
storylines.summary: June 2025: Luis proposes rebuilding the studio's shared design system. Kasia owns colour tokens, Anil the component library. September: the dark theme breaks contrast on three clients' palettes. 12 Dec 2025: v2 released at the studio's Christmas show-and-tell.

storylines.title: Offsite in Margate
storylines.summary: 29 Sep 2025: Natasha books a hotel on the Margate seafront for 6-7 November. Luis runs a session on design reviews that goes well; the karaoke goes less well. 7 Nov: the train home is cancelled and everyone gets a coach.

storylines.title: A recruiter who won't take no
storylines.summary: 11 Aug 2026: Duncan Shaw writes about a Head of Design role at a Series B fintech, 'up to £115k'. 26 Aug and 8 Sep: follow-ups. 10 Sep: Luis replies 'not right now, thanks'. 29 Sep: Duncan writes again with 'a slightly different role'; Luis leaves it unanswered.

storylines.title: Missing expense receipts
storylines.summary: 20 Jun 2025: Philippa finds three of Luis's expenses without receipts (two rides home after late nights preparing the Tandem pitch and a team lunch). He finds two; the third, a £23.80 ride, is written off on 25 July.

storylines.title: Jo's surprise 40th
storylines.summary: 20 Sep 2026: Ben starts a planning thread without Jo for her surprise party, Saturday 14 November, upstairs at The Eel & Anchor, Clapton, from 7pm; she thinks it's dinner for four. 2 Oct: Luis designs the invite. 8 Oct: Ben asks for £25 each towards a Krakow weekend; Luis hasn't paid. 12 Oct: Luis promises a photo slideshow by 7 November and asks everyone for photos; Ifeoma and Tom send some. 18 Oct: Jo emails Niamh, copying Luis, to check they're still free for dinner on the 14th. Ben is the fourth person Jo expects; Niamh is getting her to the pub.

storylines.title: The Marshgate Half 2026
storylines.summary: 6 Jul 2026: Gareth asks Luis to design the finisher medal. August: sketches. 28 Sep: Gareth approves the third design (a heron over the marshes). The artwork is due to the manufacturer on 23 October, and Luis still owes the final vector file. 5 Oct: marshal rota; Luis is at mile 9 from 8:30. Race Sunday 15 November, 9am start. Bea is pacing the 1:45 group.

storylines.title: Damp in the Mallory Road bathroom
storylines.summary: 2 Sep 2026: a brown patch spreads on the bathroom ceiling of Flat B, 41 Mallory Road. 3 Sep: Luis emails Imogen with photos. 10 Sep: she says a roofer will come 'next week'. 22 Sep: Desmond reports the stain coming through to his hallway. 1 Oct: Imogen says the roofer was ill, again 'next week'. 19 Oct: Luis writes more firmly; Imogen replied 21 Oct that a roofer, Gary, will come on Thursday 5 November, 9am to noon. Luis is at the offsite. Niamh is recording that morning and has asked Desmond to use the spare key; he has yet to confirm.

storylines.title: Albion Road deposit
storylines.summary: 29 Jun 2026: checkout inspection at Albion Road. 14 Jul: Olivia proposes deducting £340 of the £2,300 deposit: carpet clean £190 and a scratched door £150 (from Biscuit). 20 Jul: Luis disputes both deductions; he and Niamh had the carpets cleaned (receipt £95). 4 Aug: £1,960 returned, £340 disputed with the deposit scheme. 2 Oct: the scheme asks both sides for evidence by 23 October; Luis promised Niamh he'd upload the cleaning receipt and the check-in photos, not done yet.

storylines.title: Self assessment 2025-26
storylines.summary: 14 Sep 2026: Martin asks for the usual papers for 2025-26, plus Luis's Mexican freelance income in pounds, the Mexican invoices and evidence of tax paid, so he can check what foreign tax credit applies. 6 Oct: chaser. 20 Oct: Martin writes that he needs everything by 31 October to file comfortably before Christmas. Luis has to ask Lupita for totals covering 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026, since the Mexican annual return covers a calendar year. Fee £420 + VAT.

storylines.title: Christmas 2026 in Cork
storylines.summary: 5 Oct 2026: Bernadette asks when they're coming for Christmas and whether Luis eats ham ('Niamh says you eat everything'). 12 Oct: Niamh and Luis agree 21 to 28 December. 18 Oct: Bernie asks again which flights; Luis said he'd book once the Puffin Vale sale starts. Not booked at the anchor.

storylines.title: Five-a-side, autumn season
storylines.summary: 10 Sep 2026: Kwame opens the autumn season, Thursdays 7pm at Mabley Green pitch 3, eight fixtures from 1 October to 19 November, £45 each by 1 October. Luis plays but hasn't paid; Kwame chases on 8 Oct and 20 Oct. 15 Oct: Callum turns an ankle. Luis can't play on 5 November (offsite). Kwame intends to reconcile late payments at the end-of-year kickabout on 17 December.

storylines.title: The Albion Road boiler
storylines.summary: 4 Nov 2024: boiler fails. 6 Nov: Darren sends an engineer to diagnose it. 13 Nov: he fits a replacement valve; it holds for nine days. 22 Nov: fails again; part on order. 2 Dec: Luis asks for a rent reduction; Olivia agrees £150 off December. 10 Jan 2025: third failure on the coldest week; Agnieszka lends a fan heater. 17 Feb: Peter replaces the boiler. 24 Feb: Luis confirms it works.

storylines.title: Ski week in Les Arcs
storylines.summary: 30 Oct 2024: Tom proposes a ski week. November: chalet booked, £640 each. 24-31 Jan 2025: the trip. 3 Feb: the chalet's £160 cleaning fee is split four ways; Josh promises his £40 'this weekend'. 7 Mar: Luis reminds him once, jokily. Still unpaid in October 2026.

storylines.title: Christmas 2024 in Guadalajara
storylines.summary: 24 Oct 2024: Daniela proposes everyone home for Christmas. Luis goes 19 Dec to 5 Jan; Niamh goes to Cork. Daniela announces her engagement to Marc on Christmas Eve.

storylines.title: Aisha and Oliver's wedding
storylines.summary: 15 Jan 2025: save the date for 16 August at Lower Hatherley Barn. March: Luis is asked to be an usher. June: mustard ties posted to the ushers. 16 Aug: the wedding. 28 Aug: Aisha sends thank-you notes and the photographer's link.

storylines.title: Daniela's wedding in Guadalajara
storylines.summary: 8 Sep 2025: Daniela asks Luis to design the invitations. November: invitations approved; printed in Guadalajara. January 2026: Luis and Niamh book flights (London-Mexico City-Guadalajara, 14-27 April). March: Marc pays Luis back CA$640 for printing. 18 April 2026: wedding at Hacienda Los Siete Capulines; Luis gives the toast. 10 May: Daniela sends photos and a thank-you.

storylines.title: Shin splints
storylines.summary: 20 Mar 2025: Luis books Harriet after shin pain. Six sessions, £55 each, exercises by email. Bea adjusts his interval sessions. 30 May: discharged with a mileage cap of 40 km a week.

storylines.title: Adopting Biscuit
storylines.summary: 22 Apr 2025: Luis asks Olivia whether they can have a cat; the landlord agrees in writing on 30 April and asks for a pet clause in the renewal. 10 May: Biscuit arrives. Vaccinations with Emma at Lauriston Vets. 19 Jan 2026: Biscuit has a tooth out, £410.

storylines.title: Moving to Mallory Road
storylines.summary: 11 May 2026: the rent at Albion Road is going up £275. 29 May: notice given. 6 Jun: they find Flat B, 41 Mallory Road (Imogen's), £1,950 a month. 27 Jun: move with Tariq's van. Marta comes to Mallory Road from 10 July. 20 Jul: address changes done, mostly; Agnieszka still gets parcels.

storylines.title: Selling things before the move
storylines.summary: 5 June 2026: lists the sofa at £200, the old drafting table at £60 and the spare bike rack at £25, collection only. 13 June: the sofa sells for £180. The table buyer misses two pickups; Niamh finds a taker who collects both the table and rack on 25 June for £70. One-off buyers on a marketplace site write in.

storylines.title: A cracked molar
storylines.summary: 24 Feb 2026: Luis cracks a lower-left molar on an olive stone. Emergency slot on 26 Feb; crown prep 9 March; crown fitted 23 March (£640). 30 March: invoice and the six-month recall.

storylines.title: Self assessment 2023-24
storylines.summary: 11 Nov 2024: Martin asks for the P60, freelance income and tax paid in Mexico for 6 April 2023 to 5 April 2024. Luis sends the last statement on 20 Jan 2025. 29 Jan: Martin files; £1,940 to pay by 31 Jan.

storylines.title: Niamh changes job
storylines.summary: 19 Jan 2026: Niamh gets an offer from Lowtide Audio. 27 Feb: last day at Pellam & Rook; Chloe organises leaving drinks. 2 Mar: first day. They celebrate at a Dalston restaurant on 6 March.

storylines.title: Tuesday Book Club
storylines.summary: Monthly at Ife's. March 2026: Sunita lends Luis a 600-page novel, which he hasn't returned. September: Luis skips. Hamish hosts the November meeting on Tuesday 3 November; Mei Lin wants Luis's December pick by then. Luis has found six copies of The Unlit Landing, a short novel by Maud Sellick, in the library catalogue and is leaning towards that. He hasn't told Mei Lin yet.

storylines.title: Rebrand de Tueste Laja y Niebla
storylines.summary: 25 may 2026: Ernesto pide cotización para renovar la marca. 2 jun: Luis cotiza $86,000 MXN + IVA (logo, paleta, bolsas, menú, señalética de dos cafeterías), 50% anticipo. 9 jun: aprobada; el anticipo llega el 19 jun. Julio-agosto: tres rondas de logo; Andrea escribe el tono; Ximena fotografía el 28 de agosto. 12 sep: Luis entrega los PDF de producción; los originales editables sólo se entregan al liquidar. 15 sep: segunda factura, $43,000 + IVA, vence el 15 de octubre. 1 oct: Mariana pide los editables para la imprenta. 16 oct: Luis recuerda el pago; Emilio pide que se reenvíe el CFDI. 20 oct: Ernesto escribe que 'la próxima semana sale sin falta'; Emilio tiene que programar la transferencia para el viernes 30 de octubre. Al 22 de octubre Luis todavía tiene que reenviar el CFDI y el pago sigue pendiente.

storylines.title: Apertura de la clínica San Pedro
storylines.summary: 21 sep 2026: Paola pide la campaña de apertura de la séptima clínica, en San Pedro Garza García: lona de fachada, volantes, seis posts y una página. 5 oct: primera propuesta. 13 oct: el Dr. Garza pide que el fondo azul oscuro de la lona se limite a la franja superior para que destaque el teléfono. 19 oct: segunda propuesta enviada; Paola dice que la ve con él el viernes. Paola puede aprobar los posts; Héctor autoriza la lona y el volante. La imprenta necesita el PDF y la medida final de la lona (4 × 1.2 m) el 6 de noviembre; inauguración el 21 de noviembre. Rodrigo hace la página.

storylines.title: Lupita y los papeles de otoño
storylines.summary: 10 sep 2026: Lupita pide los estados de cuenta de julio y agosto y, en cuanto cierre el mes, el de septiembre; también pide la constancia de situación fiscal actualizada. 6 oct: segundo aviso; además el CFDI de agosto a Lobo Gris salió con uso S01 y hay que cancelarlo y reemitirlo. 13 oct: Luis promete mandar todo 'el viernes 16'. No lo mandó. 20 oct: Brenda recuerda que la declaración de octubre se presenta el 17 de noviembre. Luis también tiene que pedirle a Lupita el desglose del 6 de abril de 2025 al 5 de abril de 2026 para Martin Hale.

storylines.title: Etiqueta 'Ofrenda' de Lobo Gris
storylines.summary: 17 ago 2026: Diego pide la etiqueta de la edición de Día de Muertos, una stout de cempasúchil y cacao. 2 sep: bocetos. 18 sep: Samuel corrige datos (7.2% ABV, 34 IBU). 9 oct: archivos a la imprenta, un día tarde. 21 oct: llegan las etiquetas; Diego manda foto. Lanzamiento el 31 de octubre en la cervecería; invitan a Luis aunque esté en Londres. Pendiente: factura final ($9,500 + IVA) y el CFDI corregido de agosto.

storylines.title: Informe anual de Semilla Viva
storylines.summary: 28 sep 2026: Lucía pide el informe anual 2026, 24 páginas, para el 1 de diciembre; tarifa de ONG $28,000 MXN. 6 oct: Luis manda retícula y portada. 15 oct: Iván manda 600 fotos agrupadas por escuela. Luis necesita 12 con autorización para publicar y le pide la selección para el 26 de octubre. Lucía aprueba el texto, que Andrea promete entregar el 30 de octubre.

storylines.title: Prospecto: Quema del Patio
storylines.summary: 8 oct 2026: Alejandra escribe: quiere una tienda en línea para 24 piezas de tres talleres de Puebla, con envíos sólo dentro de México al arrancar. 14 oct: videollamada (a las 18:00 de Londres, 11:00 de Puebla). Luis promete cotización a más tardar el viernes 23 de octubre; al ancla no la ha mandado. Alejandra pregunta el 21 oct si la cotización puede separar la fotografía por pieza y el costo de cargar el catálogo.

storylines.title: Empaque de Tueste Laja y Niebla
storylines.summary: 28 oct 2024: Ernesto pide rediseñar las bolsas de 250 g y 1 kg. Diciembre: propuesta aprobada. 21 feb 2025: bolsas impresas; pago completo, puntual.

storylines.title: Señalética de Clínicas Diente de Sierra
storylines.summary: 28 oct 2024: Paola encuentra a Luis por un amigo de Rodrigo. Señalética para tres clínicas. 31 ene 2025: instalada; el Dr. Garza contento.

storylines.title: Negociación de la iguala con Clínicas Diente de Sierra
storylines.summary: 12 ene 2026: Paola propone una iguala mensual. Luis pide $28,000; el Dr. Garza ofrece $18,000. 20 feb: quedan en $22,000 + IVA por doce meses, hasta 20 horas al mes. 16 mar 2026: contrato firmado.

storylines.title: Sitio web de Casa Ocotillo
storylines.summary: 10 feb 2025: Sofía pide un sitio con reservaciones. Abril: diseño aprobado; mayo: pasan al tú. Julio: Ximena fotografía las habitaciones. Septiembre: Rodrigo integra el motor de reservas. 20 nov 2025: el sitio sale; mantenimiento de $4,500 al mes desde diciembre.

storylines.title: Mantenimiento de Casa Ocotillo
storylines.summary: Enero 2026: Renata entra y pide cambios mensuales. Junio: Jorge sube la tarifa de la habitación doble de $2,100 a $2,850 MXN para las dos semanas de Guelaguetza en julio. 30 sep 2026: Jorge reporta una reserva duplicada; Rodrigo corrige el reintento del cobro y Jorge avisa a la huésped.

storylines.title: Marca de Cervecería Lobo Gris
storylines.summary: 3 mar 2025: Diego quiere marca nueva antes de distribuir en CDMX. Mayo: el lobo gris aprobado tras cuatro rondas. 11 jul 2025: Luis entrega la marca y manda la factura por el saldo. 18 jul: Fernanda liquida.

storylines.title: Página de donativos de Semilla Viva
storylines.summary: 2 jun 2025: Lucía pide una página de donativos. Lucía aprueba $32,000 MXN por diseño y pruebas; Rodrigo factura aparte la integración. 12 sep 2025: en línea; la meta para el primer mes es $200,000 MXN.

storylines.title: Declaración anual 2024
storylines.summary: 17 feb 2025: Lupita pide papeles para la anual. Luis manda facturas de gastos tarde. 28 abr 2025: presentada, saldo a favor de $3,100.

storylines.title: Declaración anual 2025
storylines.summary: 16 feb 2026: Lupita pide papeles. Luis está en Guadalajara en abril por la boda y la ve en persona el 22 abr. 29 abr 2026: presentada; a pagar $5,480.

storylines.title: Prospecto: Montessori Patio del Fresno
storylines.summary: 12 may 2026: Ricardo pide cotización de identidad y sitio. Luis cotiza $64,000. 18 jun 2026: no les alcanza; lo retoman en 2027.

storylines.title: Bermondsey lot ten-year reunion
storylines.summary: 6 Oct 2026: Hayley proposes a weekend in a cottage in Norfolk to mark ten years since Hayley started the Bermondsey pub quiz team (Luis joined in 2020): 4-6 or 11-13 December. Andrei votes 4-6; Clara can only do 11-13; Nikhil might fly in; Rita says maybe. 16 Oct: Hayley asks everyone for a vote by 25 October and a £60 deposit once she confirms a date. She has a hold on a cottage near North Walsham until 27 October. Luis hasn't voted.

storylines.title: Deposit back from Keetons Road
storylines.summary: Luis paid the shared flat’s £1,800 deposit at 9 Keetons Road in 2020. Graham kept it on account when Luis moved out and the last flatmate renewed in 2023. 22 Oct 2024: the tenancy ends and Graham withholds £180 over a stained mattress. Luis sends the original inventory photos. 17 Jan 2025: £1,620 returned. Graham still forwards stray post now and then.

storylines.title: Stolen bike insurance claim
storylines.summary: 6 Mar 2025: the road bike is stolen outside 14 Albion Road. Claim HAL-2025-118734. Lorraine asks for the receipt and police reference. 12 Jun 2025: £680 paid (£780 less £100 excess).

storylines.title: Lisbon with Niamh
storylines.summary: 1 Jul 2025: flights booked with Puffin Vale Air. Rita plans a day in Cacilhas. Blue Room at Blue Swallow Guesthouse booked for 18-23 September. 18 Sep: flight delayed, late check-in at 23:10. 25 Sep: Joana asks for a review.

storylines.title: Felix in London
storylines.summary: 2 Apr 2025: Felix writes that he's coming for a type conference, 15-19 May, and asks for the sofa. 26 May: Felix sends a thank-you from Berlin with a PDF of the type specimen he left drying on the kitchen table.

storylines.title: Bec visits from Sydney
storylines.summary: 18 May 2026: Bec announces she'll be in London 8-21 July. Dinner at Mallory Road on 14 July, the first guest in the new flat. 22 Jul Sydney time: Bec writes after getting home; she left London on 21 July.
